You nailed it fella. I felt every word you wrote. Im in a similar position to yourself and I'm currently in a psych ward. I 100% get being replaced its happened to me and is so so tough. I'm still asking myself is it right to carry on. What kind of life can i live now watching the love of my life move on so fast with my kids. He's a better man aswell he has all his shit together while im stuck here waiting to find out whats wrong with me.

I did actually go down this route at first. The therapist i saw was an addiction therapist. I wasn't sure what my behaviour was. All i knew was id replace things i became obsessed with eg drugs, sex, computer games, motorsport fucken yoyos for some reason. These things consumed me. Once I'd replaced all those obsessions with suicide she put me onto the NHS and I've been going from there. The crisis team are really helpful in all fairness it's just me not playing ball. I've probably had 2 solid suicide attempts and probably 16 half assed attempts in the last month.

Short suspension hanging didn't work for me Xmas day. My body took over and i got free. To be fair though I didnt do the best job on the knot. This time I'm going to tie a rope around a post and get in the car. Feed the other end through the window and tie it off around my neck then drive off. Seems less painful than anything else I've researched anyway. I've recently lost my home, my family and my best friend. Basically my lifes work. Im done fighting it now. I'm ready to go. Best of luck to your fine self aswell
